title: Cobblemon More PC Info
description: Client-side panel for Cobblemon's PC GUI. Hover or select a Pokémon to see its size, ability, nature, Tera type, aspects and color-coded IVs. Configurable, with toggle keybind and Mod Menu support.
body:
# Cobblemon More PC Info

Hover over any Pokémon in your PC and see all the info you need — no clicks, no pulling them out of storage.

**Client-side only.** Works on any server.

---

## Features

- Name, gender, box/party slot, Poké Ball
- Size, ability *(Hidden marked)*, nature *(Minted marked)*
- Tera type, aspects, IVs *(color-coded: green = 31, red = 0)*

## Config *(via Mod Menu)*

Side, position offsets, hover delay, drop shadow, fade-in, aspect tooltip, toggle keybind.

---

## Requirements

**Minecraft 1.21.1 — Fabric & NeoForge**

| | Fabric | NeoForge |
|---|---|---|
| Required | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin | NeoForge 21.1+, Kotlin for Forge 5+ |
| Optional | Mod Menu | — |

Cobblemon 1.7+ required on both.
